prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink blob sprite sheet called The Slightly Lost Patrol. Original image inputs guide complete footless continuous charcoal-plum splat silhouettes, tiny goo hands, thick sculpted filled eyelids, ivory sclera, distinct red iris and black pupil. The fictional Pfadfinder are conveyed through relative body proportions, facial attitude and props. All are soft organic ink blobs with simple age-appropriate clothing accents. No actual humans. Six independent full characters in a strict 3-column by 2-row landscape sheet, 1536×1024 PNG with real transparent alpha. Equal substantial scale within this sheet. Keep silhouettes and all props within generous clear alpha gutters and canvas margins. No background scene, shadow disc, frame, text, logo or branding. Smooth softly satin handmade plasticine with sparse larger modeled marks, broad fabric folds, smooth glass and finished plastic. No grit or crust. Teeth behind lips. No inherited reference wings, eyepatches or costumes. Muted moss, ochre, cream and burnt orange. Compact matching neckerchiefs with blank stitched patches.
Row-major cast:
1. Female-read confused navigator. upright narrow pear, wide worried eyes, small round mouth. Key cue: one large clear compass held sideways, simple needle.
2. Male-read proud knot maker. broad low blob, raised self-assured eyebrows and closed grin. Key cue: one short thick rope tied into a clear tidy knot.
3. Male-read patient camp cook. round squat splat, gentle eyes and quiet smile. Key cue: small green enamel kettle with handle, no flame.
4. Female-read alert track reader. curved upright blob, intent sideways gaze and tight lips. Key cue: one small clay footprint cast and short magnifier.
5. Male-read weary kit carrier. broad leaning bean, low lids and weary frown. Key cue: short rolled bedroll tied with two thick bands.
6. Male-read earnest badge learner. square soft blob, crooked worried gaze and mouth drawn inward. Key cue: round blank patch and short thick sewing needle with rounded point.
All six whole ink blobs are distinct and easy to isolate. Simple readable surreal props and varied expressions.
